title: Summer light in Helsinki
subtitle: Green tram routes, the harbour and city centre, evening clouds over Töölönlahti, and a quiet shoreline walk through Arabianranta.

cover.alt: Evening clouds reflected across the calm water of Töölönlahti, with trees and distant city landmarks along the shore.
cover.caption: Evening clouds reflected across the calm water of Töölönlahti, with trees and distant city landmarks along the shore.

chapters.title: Green routes through the city
paragraphs: The first walks follow leafy paths and grassy tram tracks. A small delivery robot passes the shopfronts, and the streets take on a deep blue sky near midnight.

chapters.title: From the neighbourhood to Töölönlahti
paragraphs: Morning light reaches quiet streets and exposed rock before the route opens onto the bay. Geese gather beside the water; farther into the centre, the Parliament House and curved walls of Kiasma come into view.

chapters.title: The harbour and the city centre
paragraphs: The afternoon takes in boats, orange market tents and the shaded paths of Esplanadi. Statues, trams and the station’s clock tower continue the walk through central Helsinki.

chapters.title: An evening around the bay
paragraphs: Clouds catch the evening light above glass façades and quiet paths. The return walk passes a hare, the railway and the rising curves of a roller coaster before the sunset reaches the neighbourhood streets.

chapters.title: Trams and the quiet shore of Arabianranta
paragraphs: A tram passes beneath the trees in the morning. The later walk follows pale evening light to the shore, where geese rest in the grass. Brick buildings, public art and leafy paths complete the route through Arabianranta.
